decisions.reason: The plug-ins build on the established offer and have a dedicated page, so the firm has invested in them and committed to them publicly, and dropping them would write off visible effort.

The digital twin service extends the established offer and fits the announced strategic direction, so any early weak results can still be attributed to temporary market immaturity, which favors persisting.

The authentication service is close to the core and needed little investment, but it overlaps with the identity service, so it is somewhat at risk of being consolidated even though there is no strong reason to drop it now.
The open framework embodies the firm's stated open, extensible component strategy, so dropping it would contradict its publicly announced direction.
The identity service was announced publicly as new and integral to GeoIT integration, which creates strong commitment and a need to justify the launch decision.
